verdict.rationale: ADK is itself an official Google SDK and agent framework. It ships a first-party GitHub repo (google/adk-python) with code-first agent definitions and a documented `Agent(...)` API example. Docs state it is available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin. Missing for 10: substantive evidence for the non-Python SDKs beyond a single availability mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
